title: Were You Born in July
author: Great Aim Society
description: Were You Born in July? The Character, the Talents, the Strong Points, the Weak Points of Those Born in July, a booklet in the 'When Were You Born' series published by the Great Aim Society of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, and Toronto, Canada, in the early twentieth century and priced at ten cents. Based on popular astrology for the Sun signs of the month (Cancer and Leo), it describes the typical temperament, talents, health, best occupations, friendships and marriages of people born in July, and offers advice on developing their strengths and overcoming their weaknesses. It is a small ephemeral example of the mass-market astrology and self-improvement pamphlets of its period, preserved in the Edith and Lorne Pierce Collection of Canadiana at Queen's University.
